title: Independent navigation fusion timing declaration
description: Data-only metadata_declarations.fusion_timing contract. The current firmware catalog does not emit or enable this mode parameter. A declaration does not establish numerical replay support or hardware validation.

application_time.description: legacy_algorithm_epoch preserves the recorded algorithm's application rule: KF6 untrusted zero-delay uses estimator present; otherwise KF6 and ESKF15 use their resolved measurement epoch. It must not be inferred as identical to source_time for every legacy input.
